fusions.name: Tongue Lash
fusions.desc: A lashing blow that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Chorus Croak
fusions.desc: Booms a cone 6 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
